title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-20
lineage: reel > AKAI GX625 > Apogee Mini Me (24/96) > Apogee Mini  Dac (monitoring) > Wavelab 5.0 (dithered to 16/44) > CD > EAC > Wav > Flac16
source: MR > R Heavily Edited > R @ 71/2ips > CD

ai_review.summary: Pitch‑off soundboard recording, but the acoustic set – especially an excellent acoustic Truckin' – shines.
ai_review.review: The source is a soundboard (sbd) that suffers from a noticeable half‑tone low pitch and is generally considered inferior to the Sirmick remaster.  On the musical side, listeners praise the acoustic portion of the show, highlighting a tasty acoustic Truckin' and a well‑executed train‑whistle intro before Casey Jones.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality receives a solid positive note (4★) while recording quality is rated very low (average ~0.5★). Weighted combination yields an overall rating around 3★.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Pitch is about a half‑tone flat; reviewers say this version sounds worse than the Sirmick remaster and offers no upgrade.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic set is highlighted as tasty, with particular praise for acoustic Truckin' and the train‑whistle intro to Casey Jones; no other set details provided.

band_member_comments.Bob: His vocal delivery on acoustic Truckin' was praised ('Bobby grind those lyrics').
